explanation.what_it_is: The Compliance API now returns transcripts of Cowork and Claude Code sessions that run on users' machines, allowing for the retrieval of conversation records.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Enterprise organizations to access and review transcripts of local sessions, which can be useful for auditing, logging, or compliance purposes.

explanation.what_it_is: The Claude API now includes an 'anthropic-workspace-id' response header that contains the ID of the workspace associated with the API key or access token used in the request.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows developers to determine which workspace is being accessed through the API, enabling better tracking and management of API requests.
how_to_use: Check the 'anthropic-workspace-id' header in API responses to verify the workspace ID
Use the workspace ID to log or audit API requests for specific workspaces

items.title: You can now set a budget on a Claude Managed Agents session: a hard cap on the…

explanation.what_it_is: A hard cap on the spend for a Claude Managed Agents session, priced at public list rates, which pauses the session when the budget is reached.
explanation.why_it_matters: This allows Claude Code users to better control costs and prevent unexpected expenses, by setting a maximum spend for each session.
how_to_use: Set a budget when creating a new Claude Managed Agents session to limit its spend
Use the budget_reached stop signal to trigger actions when a session reaches its budget cap

items.title: You can now give a Claude Managed Agents session an advisor: a model at least…
items.summary: You can now give a Claude Managed Agents session an advisor: a model at least as capable as the agent's own that the session's primary thread can consult mid-turn for strategic guidance. Configure it…

explanation.what_it_is: A Claude Managed Agents session can now be assigned an advisor, which is a model that provides strategic guidance to the session's primary thread during its turn.
explanation.why_it_matters: This allows for more informed decision-making within the session, as the advisor can offer guidance based on its capabilities, which are at least as strong as the agent's own.
how_to_use: Configure an advisor model for a Claude Managed Agents session to provide mid-turn strategic guidance
Use the advisor to inform the agent's decisions, such as evaluating potential actions or predicting outcomes
